notes: Complete individual Mariinskyi Palace exterior: mint-blue/cream two-story main palace, three projecting raised risalits/crowns, curved rear hall, shallow gray-blue hipped roofs and chimneys, attached low U wings and extended transverse end annexes. Real recessed glazing/closed portals, cream columns and original simplified curved ornament/open roof balustrades. Main forecourt and small rear service court stay roof-free. Independent Rada, administrative buildings, park and fountains remain native. No copied statues, heraldry, inscriptions, event furniture or interiors. Original medium-fi interpretation of ornate pediments, window/urn inventories, rear elevations, concealed roof joints and historic grades. The native small rear service-court void is retained, without inventing unverified glazing. Main courtyard gardens/fountains and independent city buildings stay outside the model. Physical-device timings and numerical LOD errors remain unmeasured. Four owned native components are replaced; all71 neighbors remain independent.
